dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many concrete, expert‑level thresholds (e.g., LastPingDateTime > 1 hour = UNMANAGED, CRITICAL missing patches = NONCOMPLIANT, specific IAM policy names, required VPC endpoints) that a generic model would not know. However it omits some nuanced guidance such as exact patch‑severity handling for HIGH on internal vs external instances and does not spell out regional default baseline precedence, leaving a small knowledge gap.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific audit mindset (worst‑finding precedence, pre‑flight IAM/VPC checks, ordered dimension evaluation) and detailed remediation CLI steps. A few procedures are phrased generically (e.g., "check security groups") rather than naming exact AWS CLI filters, which prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasoning (e.g., never treat Success association as patch proof, never classify UNMANAGED solely from missing API data). Missing a couple of common pitfalls such as ignoring SSM rate‑limit errors and over‑relying on default security‑group rules, so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter includes all required fields (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, metadata, activation triggers, invocation schema). Description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides reliable activation triggers.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Layers information: one‑line takeaway, quick matrix, pre‑flight, ordered steps, edge‑case handling, anti‑patterns, safety checks, remediation, deep reference. However, the early quick‑reference matrix and extensive deep reference may overload a first read, causing some cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates freedom precisely: destructive actions require explicit CONFIRM prompts, single‑instance targeting, rate‑control guidance, and clear separation between audit (read‑only) and remediation (state‑changing). No over‑ or under‑constraining observed.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Quick reference → Pre‑flight → Process → Aggregation → Output → Edge‑cases → Anti‑patterns → Safety checks → Remediation → Deep reference) that aligns with the reference skill architecture.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a deterministic output format, decision tree, concrete remediation CLI snippets, handling of malformed input, and worked examples that an agent can execute. Slight gap: no ready‑to‑run script for pagination loops, requiring the agent to synthesize that logic.
